Bind known artifact-specific feature/candidate fields explicitly, retaining original context for historical dependency proofs. Define a concrete Root operator-application shape that reuses standing authority without treating an automated gate as consent.

It declares no capture-result reference from which actual argv/exit/candidate/producer can be cross-checked. Keep expected exit/outcome/diagnostic independently frozen; contradictory capture exit/setup/transport must reject despite receipt passed/exit0/PASS text.
